config.uselessreptile.group.dragonBehavi: Options for changing behavior of dragons in game
config.uselessreptile.group.camera.@Tool: Settings for camera when you riding the dragon
config.uselessreptile.group.dragonAppear: Options to change how dragons look
config.uselessreptile.group.groupSize.@T: Defines group sizes of dragons when they spawn naturally. Minimal group size always must be equal or less than maximum one.
config.uselessreptile.group.globalMultip: Multipliers for specific base attribute of ALL dragons
config.uselessreptile.group.dragonAttrib:
Base dragon attributes. Note that in vanilla game attribute values are limited by certain range (this can be changed by other mods): 
§6Damage: §c[0;2048] 
§6Knockback: §c[0;5] 
§6Health: §c[1;1024] 
§6Armor: §c[0;30] 
§6Armor toughness: §c[0;20] 
§6Ground, flying and vertical speed: §c[0;1024] 
§6Rotation speeds: §c[0;180] 
§6Attack cooldowns: §c[0;2048] 
§6Acceleration duration: §c[0;2048 
§fAttack cooldowns and acceleration duration are measured in ticks, rotation speeds - in degrees. Movement speed is measured in corgi-sized meteors
config.uselessreptile.group.inWorldSpawn: Allows to configure whenever certain dragons can appear in world
config.uselessreptile.option.blockDropCh: Defines percentage of blocks that will be dropped after some of block-breaking dragon attacks
config.uselessreptile.option.allowDragon:
Defines if dragons can destroy blocks or not.
Allowed values: 
§3ALL §f(all can break), 
§3TAMED §f(only tamed can), 
§3DISABLED §f(none can break)
config.uselessreptile.option.enableCamer:
Enables camera offset in 3rd person while riding the dragon
If off, offsets will not be applied
config.uselessreptile.option.enableCross: Enables crosshair in 3rd person while riding the dragon
config.uselessreptile.option.autoThirdPe: Automatically switches perspectives when starting and stopping riding the dragon
config.uselessreptile.option.disableName: Prevents special textures and models from applying and uses default instead
config.uselessreptile.option.disableEmis: Prevents rendering of glowing layer on dragon
config.uselessreptile.option.attackBoxes: Enables rendering of boundaries of dragon attack boxes when hitbox debug is enables
config.uselessreptile.option.lightningCh: Chance of Lightning Chaser to appear every time when game attempts to spawn it during thunderstorm
config.uselessreptile.option.dragonMinGr: Minimal size of a naturally spawned mob group
config.uselessreptile.option.dragonMaxGr: Maximum size of a naturally spawned mob group
config.uselessreptile.option.riddenDrago: Multiplies base ground speed of all rideable dragons when they're controlled by rider
Multiplies base flying speed of all rideable dragons when they're controlled by rider
config.uselessreptile.option.dragonVerti: Responsible for diving and ascending speed when flying
config.uselessreptile.option.dragonBaseA: Time in ticks that takes dragon to fully accelerate
config.uselessreptile.option.dragonRotat: Rotation speed of the dragon when it's on ground
Rotation speed of the dragon when it's in air
config.uselessreptile.option.lightningCh: Melee and shockwave attack cooldown (in ticks). Note: shockwave attack cooldown is always 10 times bigger than one in this field
config.uselessreptile.option.spawnGroupC:
Maximum capacity of this group. 
Group includes following entities: %s
config.uselessreptile.option.lightningCh: Amount of time (in ticks) that must pass before Lightning Chaser can attempt to spawn near the same player
config.uselessreptile.option.dragonMadne: All (untamed) dragons now attack players on sight
config.uselessreptile.option.allowDragon: Allows tamed dragons to teleport whenever they attempt to follow the owner and happen to be too far away
config.uselessreptile.option.naturalSpaw: Enables natural spawning of this dragon
config.uselessreptile.option.naturalLigh:
Enables natural spawn of Lightning Chaser in world. This doesn't affect its spawn during thunderstorms
Note: Lightning Chaser does not have spawns for variants defined that can spawn naturally. You have to add them on your own via datapack or otherwise dragon will not be able to spawn in this way due not having available variants
config.uselessreptile.option.hideEquipme: Hides info in item tooltip about which dragons can equip specific item
config.uselessreptile.option.renderPasse:
Defines if passenger on dragons can be rendered.
Allowed values: 
§3ALL §f(all passengers will be rendered), 
§3SELF §f(only you as passenger can be rendered), 
§3OTHERS §f(anyone but you as passenger can be rendered), 
§3NONE §f(no passengers will be rendered)
config.uselessreptile.option.upDownCamer: Allows using camera pitch for up/down input for flying dragons
Defines minimal deviation of camera pitch for up/down input to be active
config.uselessreptile.option.magmamunche:
Defines for how long fire resistance from Magmamuncher consuming fuel item will last.
Setting value to 0 will disable this feature
